chapter: Europe and the Black and Blue years
title: Milt Buckner's death and his health
summary: A caller from Switzerland checked on her health. They discuss Milt Buckner's heart attack after trouble lifting his organ gear, his marriage to Monestier's wife, and Dr. Chavron's blood tests that revealed his high blood pressure and diabetes.
